about_the_game:
(This game is still in early development, a demo will be available soon)

Story

The world slowly approaches its final destination. No longer should mankind be shrouded in chaos and suffering. Yet what awaits them instead, is the madness of creation.

Following centuries of peace, prosperity, and technological advancement, the two nations in the inner continent wage war over mankind's ticket to godhood. In an era where things as pitiful as power, resources, or territory hold little importance, the nations fight not for the possession of divinity, but the right of blasphemy.

The story follows Nana and Kate, current members of the once legendary one hundred and first platoon. Even though the platoon was completely annihilated after one vicious battle, it did not dissolve and instead received new members. Nonetheless, every member, including Nana and Kate, knows very well that the platoon is not the elite unit it once was. It is but a shadow of its former self, a mascot of the Venetican military, a fact that (almost) all members of the platoon are content with. Their tranquil lives, however, are soon to be interrupted. Even if they do not know it yet, their fates will inevitably clash with the impending end of days.

Features

  • Rich story and plot

  • One-hit-kill combat (with shield mechanics)

  • Power-up items

  • Puzzles

  • Adjustable difficulty

name: Carpet101
short_description: A story-rich pixel-art sidescroller RPG with one-hit-kill combat. Follow the adventures of Nana and Kate, members of the one hundred and first platoon of the Venetican military. Help them overcome tough enemies and uncover the truth behind it all.
